conviction_note: Q3 EBITDA and EBIT were pre-released by ad-hoc on 2026-10-26 (underlying about 0.5% below consensus, headline beat entirely the EUR 24m MAS one-off, guide held). What the release adds is Q3 free cash flow, which the held FY target arithmetically implies is at or above a record, but JPMorgan said so publicly that day and the stock rose 2.6% on it. Against that sit a +9.4% 20-day run-up (+4.3% on 2 Nov in a sector rally) and Lufthansa's 3 Nov comments on thinning its network. Scale is about 3.3% at p_up 53, so +0.2 scaled. The findings sum to -0.2 because the run-up and read-through negatives slightly outweigh the cash positive. Both numbers are near zero with opposite signs, and that is the honest result: nothing here decides the print.

findings.finding: The FY2026 free cash flow target ('low triple-digit million euro range', positive) was explicitly held in the 26 Oct ad-hoc, when management already knew Q3 cash. After H1 FCF of -EUR 367.9m and a Q4 that ran about -EUR 24m in 2025 (FY 24.4m less 9M 48.2m), the held target implies Q3 2026 FCF of roughly EUR 450-600m, above the EUR 373m record of Q3 2025.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 (11 Nov 2025): record Q3 FCF of EUR 373m, JPMorgan singled out the FCF, stock +8% intraday and +6.48% close. H1 2026 (6 Aug 2026): FCF -EUR 368m and net profit halved, stock -2.5% intraday and -0.81% close
findings.source_date: 2025-11-11 (Q3 2025 FCF base); H1 2026 FCF and FY target from https://quartr.com/events/fraport-ag-fra-q2-2026_3YGp98cz (Q2 2026 summary, August 2026); guide held per ad-hoc 2026-10-26
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. JPMorgan wrote on 26 Oct that the positive reaction reflects investors assuming strong Q3 FCF, and the stock rose 2.6% that day and 6.3% since. What is not priced is the size: no Q3 FCF consensus is published and the market has not seen the number. A print at EUR 500m+ (a new record) would read differently from one around EUR 400m that leaves Q4 to deliver.

findings.finding: Underlying Q3 EBITDA of about EUR 571m (595 less the 24 MAS one-off) puts 9M underlying EBITDA at about EUR 1,153m, roughly level with 9M 2025 (about 561 + 593). That leaves the FY run-rate at the low end of the 'über 1,44 Milliarden und bis zu 1,5 Milliarden Euro' guide ex-MAS, so the final release may steer to the lower half.

findings.original_quote: Ohne diesen Sondereffekt hätte der operative Gewinn (Ebitda) die Analystenerwartung von 574 Millionen Euro knapp verfehlt. (Without this one-off, operating profit (EBITDA) would have narrowly missed the analyst expectation of EUR 574m.)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the underlying miss was reported in German and English on 26 Oct. What is left is whether management's wording on 4 Nov moves from 'maintained' to 'lower end'. A market expecting that would have sold the ad-hoc, and it bought it.

findings.finding: Lufthansa, Frankfurt's dominant carrier, reported on 3 Nov that it is thinning its European feeder network and has reviewed and partly cut connections at over half of 200+ European destinations (23 aircraft saved). It expects double-digit ticket price rises in 2027 on kerosene costs, a headwind to 2027 Frankfurt passenger volumes that Fraport will be asked about on 4 Nov.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Traffic-outlook surprises have moved this stock: 13 Jul 2026 Frankfurt passenger guide cut, -3.26%. 6 Oct 2026 Barclays downgrade to Underweight on weaker winter traffic, -1.14% that day and -6% over three sessions
findings.original_quote: Weil gleichzeitig neue Flugzeuge knapp sind, dünnt die Airline-Gruppe ihr Netz aus und konzentriert sich auf wohlhabende Kunden, die Premium-Sitze buchen. ... 'Die Ticketpreise werden im nächsten Jahr zweistellig steigen.' (Because new aircraft are also scarce, the group is thinning its network and focusing on wealthy customers booking premium seats. ... 'Ticket prices will rise by double digits next year.')
findings.why_not_priced: Public today and Fraport traded flat (-0.4%) while Lufthansa rose 4-6%, so the market read Lufthansa's day as airline-positive and has not visibly applied it to Fraport's 2027 volumes. Transmission to Fraport's own outlook is a hypothesis until Fraport comments on 4 Nov. Lufthansa also expanded its summer 2027 schedule on 20 Oct, which cuts against this.

baseline_tension: The baseline lean (-0.47, run-up only) and the +9.4% run-up point slightly negative. The one real new line, Q3 cash, points slightly positive and is partly priced, so the evidence roughly offsets and leaves the call close to a coin flip.

lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': September traffic finding +0.1 to 0.0, and the EBITDA low-end finding -0.4 to -0.2, since it rests on pre-released numbers
'A beat made of a one-off is sold': the headline EBITDA beat is the MAS one-off, so p_up 55 to 53
'The move is in the guide' (reiterated guide, median move 2.3%) against new cash-flow lines: abs_move_pct 3.5 to 3.3
Macro-to-company transmission is a hypothesis: Lufthansa read-through -0.5 to -0.4
'Cash can outweigh a raised guide' confirms that free cash flow is the line to watch; the FCF finding stays at +0.8
